newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LIETUVA HOTEL POSTS PROFIT IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: LIETUVA HOTEL POSTS PROFIT IN APRIL.

text.p: Lithuana's biggest hotel, the Lietuva Hotel, said on Wednesday that its net profit in April was 147,000 litas.
The hotel's finance officer, Eugenija Krivoshejeva, also told Reuters that the hotel's turnover was 894,000 litas in April.
The hotel reported earlier that its losses during the first three months of the year amounted to 419,000 litas on turnover of 1.7 million litas.
"The hotel makes all its profit during the second and the third quarters of the year during the tourist season," Krivoshejeva said.
She also said that the hotel was operating at 26.8 percent capacity in April compared to 18.6 percent in the same period last year.
The hotel reported a net profit of 817,000 litas in 1996.
It is listed on the A group of the Vilnius bourse.
The state-run hotel has been slated for privatisation but it has attracted little interest from foreign investors so far.
